full_prompt_en: A textured storybook illustration shows a red-hooded child standing beside a small seated yellow wind-up robot against a cracked plaster wall. The warm beige wall occupies most of the square image, with hairline fractures, rubbed stains and missing plaster exposing pale reddish bricks. A larger vertical patch of exposed masonry rises behind the gap between the two figures. The ground forms a narrow dusty band along the bottom, scattered with small stones and fragments from the wall. On the right, the child faces left in a red hooded jacket, blue trousers and low red-and-cream shoes. The oversized hood encloses a smooth pale oval without clearly drawn facial features. Its pointed rear corner projects toward the right, while the broad face opening turns toward the smaller figure. The jacket reaches the hips, and a small pale hand hangs below the sleeve on the right side of the body. The child’s legs remain straight and close together, with both shoes planted on the ground. On the left, the yellow robot sits against the wall with a compact rounded body, short jointed arms and legs bent forward. Its round pale faceplate is surrounded by a dark rim and bears sparse small dark marks. A square loop-like winding key projects diagonally above the yellow head, distinguishing it from a hooded human figure. Dark seams and rubbed edges divide the mustard-yellow shell, and red toe sections extend in front of its feet. A tall narrow glass bottle stands upright in the gap, slightly closer to the robot. Its pale amber outline, long neck and faded light label remain visible against the wall. The bottle separates the two figures without obscuring their faces or body outlines. Fine dark drawing lines define worn material, clothing folds and cracks, with softly mottled paint filling the larger areas. Diffuse light keeps the wall relatively flat while small shadows gather behind the figures and along the rubble at its base. Red and mustard yellow provide concentrated warmth against dusty cream, brown and muted blue. The overall composition gives the standing child and seated toy a quiet face-to-face relationship, using their unequal heights, the upright bottle and the broad weathered wall to create a spare, slightly uncanny scene.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅富有肌理的童书插画：红兜帽孩子站在一只坐着的黄色发条机器人旁，身后是开裂灰泥墙。暖米色墙面占据方形画面的大部分，细裂缝、擦旧污痕与缺失灰泥交织，局部露出浅红砖。两者间隙后方有一块较大的竖向露砖区域。地面沿下缘形成狭窄尘土带，散布小石子和墙体碎屑。右侧孩子面朝左，穿红色连帽夹克、蓝裤和红色配奶油白的低帮鞋。宽大兜帽围住平滑浅色椭圆面孔，没有清楚画出的五官。帽子后方尖角向右突出，较宽的脸部开口朝向较小身影。夹克下摆到髋部，身体右侧袖口下垂着一只小小浅色手。孩子双腿伸直、距离较近，两只鞋都踩在地面上。左侧黄色机器人靠墙坐着，身体紧凑圆润，带短小分节手臂，双腿向前弯曲。圆形浅色面板被深色边框围住，其上只有稀疏小暗痕。一个方环状发条钥匙斜伸出黄色头顶，使它与戴兜帽的人类形象区分开来。暗缝与磨损边缘分割芥末黄色外壳，双脚前方伸出红色鞋尖状部分。两者间隙中直立着一只细长玻璃瓶，稍靠近机器人。浅琥珀色瓶身轮廓、长颈和褪色浅标签在墙前可辨。瓶子分隔两个身影，却不遮住面孔或身体轮廓。细深线条勾勒旧化材料、衣褶与裂纹，较大的区域填以柔和斑驳颜色。漫射光让墙面保持较平坦的亮度，小阴影则聚在身影背后及墙脚碎屑旁。红色与芥末黄在尘旧奶油色、棕色和低饱和蓝色之间提供集中的暖意。整体构图让站立孩子与坐着的玩具安静相对，以不等高度、直立瓶子和大面积旧墙形成简洁且略带异样感的场景。
style_prompt_en: The storybook illustration combines simplified rounded volumes, fine irregular outlines and softly mottled colour. Dusty cream, grey-beige and muted brown provide a restrained ground for a few concentrated red, mustard and blue accents. Rubbed patches, tiny cracks and broken edge marks suggest age without filling every open area with detail. Dark contours remain delicate, and local shading gives the simple forms enough volume to separate them from the flatter background. Diffuse light keeps the tonal range quiet, while unequal scale and deliberate spacing create visual tension. The overall treatment balances sparse graphic shapes with tactile weathering and a gently uncanny mood.
style_prompt_zh: 童书插画把简化圆润体积、细而不规则的轮廓与柔和斑驳颜色结合起来。尘旧奶油色、灰米色和低饱和棕色构成克制底面，衬出少数集中的红、芥末黄与蓝色强调。擦旧斑块、细裂纹和断续边缘痕迹暗示年代感，却不以细节填满每一处留白。深色轮廓保持纤细，局部明暗赋予简单形体足够体积，使其与较平坦背景分开。漫射光维持安静明度，不等比例与经过安排的间距则建立视觉张力。整体处理在简洁图形、可触旧化质感与轻微异样氛围之间取得平衡。
theme_en: Red-hooded child facing a small yellow wind-up robot beside a bottle
theme_zh: 破墙前隔着玻璃瓶相对的红兜帽孩子与黄色发条机器人
name: Dran
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
